_comment: Where each bundled licence text comes from, pinned by sha256. Consumed by
scripts/check-notice.py: --update fetches/extracts these into the module's
META-INF/licenses/, the default check verifies the checked-in files still
hash to the recorded values. A fetch whose content does not match its
recorded sha256 fails -- upstream changed, and a human decides.
Every artifact whose (merged) licence is not Apache-2.0 must appear in
exactly one entry's artifacts list; check-notice.py fails otherwise, which
is the prompt to curate a new entry here. Artifacts are named as
groupId:artifactId, shared across modules and versions -- the sha pin is
what detects an upstream text change, not the version.
source.jar takes the text out of the bundled artifact's own jar (best
provenance: version-exact, publisher-shipped). source.url fetches over
HTTPS; a GITHUB_TOKEN env var or `gh auth token` is sent when present,
though raw.githubusercontent.com needs neither. Each url entry's note says
why that ref is the right one, because none of these five artifacts ships
its licence text in any jar (main jar and sources jar both checked), and
several POM-declared licence URLs point at HTML pages or bare licence

LICENSE.protobuf.note: Tag v33.2 is the release Java artifact 4.33.2 ships from (Java majors are offset by 4). The POM-declared URL is opensource.org, which serves an HTML page.

LICENSE.gax.note: The repository the gax artifacts' POMs declare. Archived, hence frozen -- which makes it a stable source; no per-version tag exists for these versions anywhere fetchable (sdk-platform-java main carries older gax than this BOM resolves). api-common's POM declares api-common-java instead, but all four artifacts now release from the same consolidated repository and carry the same Google BSD-3-Clause text, so they share this file.

LICENSE.google-auth-library.note: The project's repository, archived and frozen; it has no tag for this version (released after the move) and the POM-declared URL is opensource.org's HTML page.

LICENSE.re2j.note: The release tag for the bundled 1.8. The POM-declared URL is golang.org/LICENSE, which serves an HTML page.

LICENSE.animal-sniffer.note: The release tag for the bundled 1.27. The POM-declared URL is spdx.org's bare MIT template, which lacks the copyright line.

LICENSE.threetenbp.note: Shipped inside the artifact's own jar.

LICENSE.javax-annotation-api.note: Shipped inside the artifact's own jar.
